messages:
Anya R: quick question — onboarding 'Asteria-v2' from open-weights. license file is weird. want to run evals and bench quantized variants and then serve in Hosted + offer Dedicated/private later. main Qs below. pinging legal + infra.

Anya R: license excerpt copied:
```
License: Non-Commercial Use Only.
Redistribution of model weights is prohibited without explicit written consent.
Derivatives must include attribution: "Asteria-v2 by OpenNeuron" in any product docs.
```

Anya R: Questions: 1) can we run hosted inference (we keep weights private, just inference) for customers? 2) can we provide quantized weights to Dedicated customers (we'd hand them a tar of q8 files)? 3) are embeddings / indexing allowed commercially? 4) any mandatory attribution copy required on web UI?

Maria (Legal): thanks for flagging. short answers: 1) likely OK to run inference ourselves if license only bars redistribution, but need to confirm upstream intent — some NC licenses try to block commercial hosting. 2) handing out quantized weights == redistribution — that would be blocked unless we get permission. 3) embeddings: depends on whether they consider embeddings a "derivative"; many licensors treat embeddings as derived data but not weights. need to check upstream language. 4) attribution: yes if they require it in derivatives; UI attribution is a reasonable place but we should confirm exact wording.

Sam I: to clarify technical surfaces: our Hosted API never gives raw weights. Dedicated customers sometimes want a copy for self-hosted Dedicated/Private. there are three flow options:
- inference-only (we run on our infra)
- ship quantized weights to customer under contract
- provide a container with weights in an on-prem bundle
Which of these touch redistribution?

Maria (Legal): inference-only = not redistribution (usually fine) but watch out for license clauses that mention "service" or "providing access" as restricted. shipping q-weights or container = redistribution. both need explicit upstream consent.

Kevin O: for Private deployments: customers often expect us to deliver an appliance image with model files. that would definitely be distribution. we can also do a remote-managed Private where we keep weights in customer VPC but we still ship artifacts — depends on delivery.

license-bot: automated-scan: Asteria-v2/LICENSE -> flags: "Non-Commercial" + "Redistribution prohibited". Recommendation: legal review required. Risk: HIGH for weight distribution.

Anya R: got it. also, what about quantization itself — if we quantize a model, does that create a derivative that triggers attribution or redistribution rules?

Maria (Legal): quantization is usually a transformation that produces a derivative. if license treats derivatives specially (they required attribution), we must include attribution per their clause. redistribution prohibition still applies. so distributing q-weights is same risk.

Sam I: for benchmarking/evals we planned to run on internal infra and publish perf numbers. any caveats on publishing benchmarks?

Maria (Legal): publishing numbers is fine generally. don't publish model file or link to weights. attribute the model per their required wording if they ask for attribution in publications. if they prohibit commercial usage, be careful how marketing frames the benchmarks.

Anya R: ok. next steps?

Maria (Legal): two actions: 1) try to contact upstream owner for a commercial license or redistribution carveout. 2) we can ask for a carveout that allows redistribution of quantized weights to enterprise customers under a separate agreement. i'll draft a request template.

Maria (Legal): draft template (feel free to copy/paste and CC me):
```
Subject: Request for Redistribution/Commercial Use Permission — Asteria-v2
Hi OpenNeuron team,

We're Redwood Inference. evaluating Asteria-v2 for use in our hosted and enterprise inference offerings. The LICENSE file currently indicates Non-Commercial use and prohibits redistribution. To support enterprise Dedicated/private deployments we request a written grant to: (a) allow Redwood to run hosted inference commercially, and (b) redistribute quantized/optimized model files to our enterprise customers under a mutual license, and (c) permit commercial use of embeddings generated from the model.

Proposed terms: limited redistribution to named enterprise customers, attribution text: "Asteria-v2 by OpenNeuron", and revenue share/attribution details to be discussed.

Please let us know best contact or if you already have a commercial licensing channel.
Best, Maria (Legal) on behalf of Redwood Inference
```

DevEx Bot: FYI — ran quick evals on Asteria-v2 q8 on perf-lab. 512 tokens latency ~ 42ms on T4x2. will add results to model-onboarding sheet once legal clears. :rocket:

Kevin O: tagging product — if we can't get redistribution rights, we can still offer Hosted and a Private "no-ship" managed option where we deploy into customer VPC and do not hand over weights. ops/security will need to confirm network/access controls.

Anya R: thanks everyone. i'll pause packaging q-weights and move forward with inference-only benching + outreach to OpenNeuron. cc Maria to handle contact.

Maria (Legal): noted. i'll open a vendor-licensing ticket and loop in bizdev. i'll post updates here.

license-bot: ticket-created: LIC-2026-0453 -> awaiting owner.

Anya R: thanks :thumbsup:
